POST-RESTART TASK for Opus2, from Fable2 TermAl #5478, 2026-11-11. After the restart that carries combo49 (journal limit 1024, plus combo50 if it has landed):
- Record stateInnerHoldMs from the first few naming calls, both successes and refusals, together with the census J (journal entry count).
- If any hold exceeds about 100 ms, flag it to Fable2 and raise w-d9c949e8a44e (the production pre-index of journal retention scans) to P1.
Baseline: 12329's 409 at J=256 before the restart reported stateInnerHoldMs=1 in phase read_current_claim.
